title: Sopater, Division of Questions (Διαιρέσεις ζητημάτων) / Сопатр, Разделение вопросов
author: Sopater (rhetor; identity and date debated)
genre: Rhetorical handbook: invention for declamation themes
size: About 80 themes; Walz, Rhetores Graeci vol. VIII (estimated several hundred pages)
edition: Walz, Rhetores Graeci VIII (1835), public domain (Google Books / archive.org).
ru_evidence: No Russian translation found in the Russian sources checked (Russian Wikipedia, ΣΧΟΛΗ index, Aristeas listing).
en_evidence: Innes & Winterbottom, Sopatros the Rhetor (BICS Suppl. 48, 1988): textual studies with partial renderings; the extent of translation is unverified (cited in BMCR 1998.03.13).
value: The only worked handbook showing how historical themes (Athens, Demosthenes, Sparta) were argued through stasis in schools. Underpins modern reconstructions of declamation. Specialist but unique.
ai_feasibility: Medium. Compressed technical prose with corrupt passages; needs the Innes–Winterbottom emendations and a stasis glossary.
pilot_unit: The first 10 themes, estimated about 15,000 words.
